title: Inheritance & Interfaces
explanation: An interface lists methods without writing any of them. A class that implements it is promising to provide every one.
extends is a different tool: it inherits real code from a parent. Beacon gets Pillar's build() for free, runs it via super.build(...), then adds its own flourish.
The payoff is the loop at the bottom. It treats every item as a Structure and calls build() - and each object runs its own version. That is polymorphism.
